summary: SEC-001 regression verification: route gating (403 no-origin, 401 no-cookie), authenticated path, security headers, rate limit, and frontend connect flow. All verifications pass. Full backend pytest suite 42/42 passes; new live SEC-001 suite (10/10) passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Security fix implementation is clean: route-level dependencies (throttle -> owner -> same_origin) applied consistently to /api/bot/connect, /api/channels/resolve, /api/messages/send.
Token value is correctly scrubbed from all response bodies (verified by assertion in every live test).
Rate-limit returns Retry-After and Polish 'Zbyt wiele prób' message with proper 429 status; per-IP and per-session sliding window buckets both effective.

Security headers middleware (privacy_headers) sets Cache-Control: 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (contains 'no-store' as required) along with X-Frame-Options: DENY, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001 is fully verified. Backend pytest (42 tests) + new live SEC-001 suite (10 tests). Rate-limit test exhausts per-IP bucket for /api/bot/connect for ~60s; wait before re-running any UI connect test. UI token input is controlled React component — must use page.keyboard.type() (not fill()) so React state updates and submit button enables.
